topic: Planning fallacy: why the big expense always costs more than planned

artifacts.angle: name the bias (people underestimate the cost and time of their own plans, even after past overruns), show it (a move, a repair, a holiday), give one counter-move: plan from what the last similar thing really cost; no study figure claimed
artifacts.hook: The repair always costs more than the plan. That's a known bias, not bad luck.
